activity.notes: ATLAS uses 1913 as Tagore's representative literary-activity year in colonial India, when he received the Nobel Prize in Literature. The Activity is active_in, not allegiance to British rule.

sources.title: The Nobel Prize in Literature 1913 — NobelPrize.org
sources.citation_text: NobelPrize.org records Rabindranath Tagore as the 1913 Nobel Prize laureate in Literature; its biographical record gives his residence at the time of the award as India.
